title: 第1章 十三重龙象般若功第2章 铁头功我专打铁头功
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
“这批一共六个三流武者，四个二流武者，三个一流武者。
你可要给我一个好价钱。”
“放心，魔教教主苏道心魔功现在正在要紧关头，这种武林高手他们开价不会低的。”
……
随着一阵嘈杂的吵闹声，江辰费力的睁开了自己的眼睛。
“奇怪，我这是在哪里？”
就在上一刻，江辰在过马路的时候看到一辆失控的泥头车朝他撞了过来。
再睁开眼睛，便来到了这里。
“哎哟，没想到还有一个醒过来了，你这蒙汗药是假的吧？”
江辰看向四周，十几个身跨腰刀的锦衣卫横七竖八的躺在地上。
在桌子上还有着许多被打翻的酒菜。
就在他心中疑惑之时，一股庞杂的记忆涌入了他的脑海之中。
下一刻，江辰便知道了自己目前的处境。
他穿越了，穿越到了一个叫做大明的封建王朝。
与历史上的大明不同的是，这个世界真的存在着超凡的力量。
凡俗武夫，三流武者，二流武者，一流武者，后天，先天，宗师，大宗师，天人，法相，武圣。
这些境界每差一重，便是一重天。
原身是一个锦衣卫中的力士，境界也不过是三流武者之境。
这次是跟着他们的上司李成器，追捕杀人数十的妖僧觉明。
没想到这个李成器居然和觉明勾结了起来，将他们用麻药放倒，意图将其卖给魔教，换取修炼资源。

想到此处，江辰心中不由得悲凉万分。
“难道我刚穿越过来就要死了吗？”
就在他绝望的时候，耳边突然响起了一阵系统的提示音。
“叮！
检测到宿主即将遇到危险，是否立刻开启诛魔系统。”
“系统？”
“金手指？”
“我滴亲娘嘞，你终于到账了。”
“沓沓沓……”
此时，李成器已经提着刀慢慢走了过来。
“立刻开启！”
江辰见此情景，立刻在心中狂吼了起来。
“叮！
系统开启中……系统成功开启！”
“鉴于宿主首次绑定系统，特赠送新手大礼包一份，是否立刻开启？”
“立刻开启！”
“恭喜宿主获得十三重龙象般若功！”
content_en:
"There are a total of six third-rate warriors in this batch, four second-rate warriors, and three first-rate warriors.
You have to give me a good price. "
"Don't worry, Demon Cult Leader Su Dao's Heart Demon Art is at a critical moment now. They won't offer a low price for such a martial arts master."
…
Following a burst of noise, Jiang Chen struggled to open his eyes.
"Strange, where am I?"
Just a moment ago, Jiang Chen was crossing the road when he saw an out-of-control dump truck crashing into him.
When I opened my eyes again, I came here.
"Ouch, I didn't expect another one to wake up. Is your sweat medicine fake?"
Jiang Chen looked around, and saw a dozen or so guards in golden uniforms with swords on their waists lying on the ground.
There were many spilled food and drinks on the table.
Just when he was doubting, a huge amount of memories poured into his mind.
The next moment, Jiang Chen knew his current situation.
He traveled through time and space to a feudal dynasty called the Ming Dynasty.
Unlike the Ming Dynasty in history, extraordinary power really exists in this world.
Ordinary martial artist, third-rate warrior, second-rate warrior, first-rate warrior, acquired, innate, master, great master, heavenly being, Dharma minister, martial sage.
Every time these realms differ by one level, it is the next level of heaven.
He was originally a warrior in the Imperial Guard, and his realm was only that of a third-rate warrior.
This time, they followed their boss Li Chengqi to hunt down the monster monk Jueming who had killed dozens of people.
Unexpectedly, this Li Chengqi actually colluded with Jueming and knocked them down with anesthesia, intending to sell them to the Demon Cult in exchange for cultivation resources.
Thinking of this, Jiang Chen couldn't help but feel extremely sad.
"Am I going to die just after I traveled through time?"
Just when he was desperate, a system notification suddenly sounded in his ears.
“Ding!
If it is detected that the host is about to encounter danger, whether to activate the demon-killing system immediately. "
"System?"
"Goldfinger?"
"My dear mother, you finally got your account."
“Da da da…”
At this time, Li Chengqi had slowly walked over with a knife in hand.
"Open it now!"
When Jiang Chen saw this scene, he immediately roared in his heart.
“Ding!
The system is starting...The system is starting successfully! "
"Since the host is bound to the system for the first time, we are giving you a gift package for newbies. Do you want to open it immediately?"
"Open it now!"
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining the thirteenth level of Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu!"
